headline: Eurasian Economic Union plans anti-dumping duties on truck tires from Thailand and Vietnam, involving Chinese tire companies' overseas factories
summary: The Eurasian Economic Commission recommended anti-dumping duties of 11.31% to 22.37% on truck tires from Thailand and Vietnam. The move targets factories there run by Chinese companies, including Triangle, Sailun, Kingyu and Guizhou Tyre.
why: The Eurasian Economic Union is a Russia-led customs union, so its trade duties change import costs for member states. Anti-dumping duties are used to offset imports sold below fair value and can reshape tire supply chains.
